name: Sainte-Canard
coords: x east, y up, z south (north is -z), meters, island centered at the origin. rotY: three.js yaw, rotY 0 means the prop front (+Z in its GLB) faces +z (south). y is the prop origin height, already on the terrain.
propsSource: apps/client/public/models/props/<prop>.glb (LOD0..LOD2 child nodes), colliders in colliders.json, LOD distances and loot points in manifest.json

terrain.heightsEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWHF', version 1, samples per side 211, origin x -420, origin z -420, cell size 400 cm, 100 units per meter; then 211 x 211 int16 little endian centimeters, row-major, row along z (north to south), col along x (west to east)
terrain.groundEncoding: 16-byte header <4sHHhhHH: 'QWGP', version 1, samples per side 211, origin x, origin z, cell size cm, legend length; then 211 x 211 uint8, same order as the heights

chunks.id: chunk = cz * 4 + cx, cx = floor((x + 420) / 210), cz = floor((z + 420) / 210), clamped to 0..3

water.note: river water surface is bed + 0.6 m (wading)

drop.pathRule: pick one of the paths with the match seed (index = seed mod 8), or any straight line through the 300 m center disc

glide.note: about 500 m sideways from 180 m; tune in constants.ts

groundSpawnsNote: fallback spawn points on open land, at least 70 m apart: late joins, bot fill, tests without the plane

circle.rule: pick the final circle from the weighted candidates first, then grow outward so every circle contains the next; keep at least 70 percent land inside each circle

lootKinds.building: floor or furniture top inside a building
lootKinds.container: top of a crate or ammo box prop (open to spawn)
